name: Yumbrad
source:
Race: Male demon
Origin: Abandoned Desert
Hobby: Experimenting
Job: Prince, Cook

Orem's older brother, Yumbrad desperately needs money to purchase weapons to defeat Rosey. It seems that he is in Zeiva Empire, but no one knows where he is.
